summary.verdict: C3 UPGRADED: triple-gluon vertex is branch-blind by construction (no gamma5 component). Gluon 'even' is forced at the interacting (self-coupling) level, not only free-field.
summary.scope: Structural: the gauge sector contains no spinor index, so every pure-gluon n-point vertex is branch-trivial. Magnitude of the self-energy (q*/d1, F162/F163) is a separate, orthogonal open item.
